evals.prompt: Look at my open github pull requests and write a message to my team to review them
evals.expected_output: A plain-text message with PRs grouped by repo, each entry showing ticket + clean title + URL, with the repo name as a section header and a short friendly opening line
expectations: Message starts with a short friendly greeting (Hi team or similar)
PRs are grouped under repository name headers
Each PR entry shows a ticket key (e.g. PROJ-1234) followed by a clean title when a ticket exists
Each PR entry includes the GitHub PR URL on its own line
A blank line separates individual PR entries within each repo group
No PR numbers like #3846 appear in the output
No inline descriptions or summaries appear below titles
No emoji appear anywhere in the output
No Markdown syntax (bold, headings, link brackets) appears in the output
Draft PRs are excluded
No conventional-commit prefix (fix:, chore:, feat:) remains in any title
